name: fetch_filings
description: Fetch SEC EDGAR filings (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, 13D/G) for a single ticker. Read-only.

form_type.description: SEC form type (e.g. "10-K", "10-Q", "8-K", "13D"). Omit for all forms.

start_date.description: ISO date — filings on or after.

end_date.description: ISO date — filings on or before.
